content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters

This architecture is a sovereign commerce stack designed for digital creators in regions where conventional payment platforms are inaccessible. It combines static site hosting (GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages), serverless backend logic (Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script), and crypto payment processing (NOWPayments) to create a fully operational online store. The core advantage is infrastructure sovereignty: creators own every component, from order storage to file delivery, with no dependency on third-party platforms. This eliminates payout delays, platform fees, and geographic restrictions. For example, USDT transactions on Tron cost under $0.10 in network fees, while Solana averages fractions of a cent per transaction—both far cheaper than traditional payment processors.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The stack operates in three layers: frontend, backend, and payment processing. The frontend is a static site hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, serving product pages and checkout forms. The backend, built with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, handles order logic and file delivery. NOWPayments integrates via webhook, verifying crypto payments on-chain and triggering instant product delivery. For example, when a buyer sends USDT on Tron, NOWPayments’ webhook fires the moment the transaction confirms, signaling the backend to release the digital product. This process bypasses intermediaries, ensuring creators receive funds directly in their wallet—no payout delays, no platform hold.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This architecture is built for digital creators in regions where Stripe, PayPal, and Gumroad are unavailable or severely restricted. These creators sell ebooks, courses, templates, and other digital products but lack the tools to collect payment globally. The stack is also ideal for creators who prioritize data ownership and infrastructure sovereignty. For instance, in Nigeria, where P2P exchanges like Binance and Patricia allow easy conversion of Bitcoin to naira, this stack provides a direct path to revenue without relying on unstable local payment systems. It’s not a workaround—it’s base-layer infrastructure designed to withstand financial isolation and currency collapse.
USDT on Tron costs under $0.10 per transaction—ideal for low-cost digital product sales.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The stack consists of free and paid tools that integrate seamlessly. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages host the static site. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend logic, such as order processing and file delivery. Supabase or Google Sheets store order data, while Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 host product files. NOWPayments processes crypto payments with a 0.5% fee, supporting 300+ cryptocurrencies. Key networks like Tron and Solana ensure low transaction fees, making the stack cost-effective. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides all blueprints and templates to deploy this architecture, ensuring creators can build and scale without technical bottlenecks.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy this stack, start by choosing your hosting platform (GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages) and backend tool (Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script). Integrate NOWPayments by setting up a webhook to verify transactions and trigger product delivery. Use Supabase or Google Sheets to store order data and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 to host product files. Test the stack end-to-end to ensure seamless payment processing and file delivery. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes step-by-step blueprints and templates for all components, available for instant download at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. Deploy in 48 hours and own your commerce infrastructure permanently.
How do I receive crypto payments for my digital products?

To receive crypto payments for digital products, integrate NOWPayments with a static site hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Use Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and set up a webhook to verify payments and trigger product delivery. For example, USDT payments on Tron arrive in minutes with network fees under $0.10, compared to PayPal’s 2-5 business day settlement and higher fees. This architecture ensures instant payouts and full data ownership, bypassing platform restrictions.
Solana’s transaction fees average fractions of a cent, making it the fastest and cheapest network for crypto payments.

It covers everything from static site hosting to NOWPayments integration, available for instant download at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. For creators in Nigeria, Ghana, and Kenya, the kit also includes guides for converting Bitcoin to local currency via P2P exchanges like Binance and Patricia, ensuring end-to-end financial sovereignty.
Your Deployment Checklist

Choose your hosting platform: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Set up your backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Integrate NOWPayments by configuring a webhook to verify crypto payments. Store order data in Supabase or Google Sheets. Host product files on Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Test the stack end-to-end to ensure seamless payment processing and file delivery. Deploy your stack and load your first 3-5 products. Configure SPF/DKIM/DMARC for email deliverability if using email notifications. Purchase the Complete Builder Kit ($197) for all blueprints and templates at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I integrate NOWPayments with a static site?

Add NOWPayments’ payment form to your static site’s checkout page. Set up a webhook in NOWPayments to send transaction confirmation to your backend. Use Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to process the webhook and trigger product delivery.
What are the transaction fees for USDT on Tron and Solana?

USDT transactions on Tron cost under $0.10 in network fees, while Solana averages fractions of a cent per transaction. Both networks offer fast confirmation times, making them ideal for low-cost, high-speed payments.
How do creators in Nigeria convert Bitcoin to naira?

Use P2P exchanges like Binance or Patricia to convert Bitcoin to naira. These platforms connect buyers and sellers directly, ensuring fast and secure transactions. Pair this with a sovereign commerce stack to control your entire payment flow.
Can I use this stack if I’m not a developer?

Yes. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes step-by-step blueprints and templates for deploying the stack without coding expertise. Follow the guides to set up hosting, backend logic, and payment processing.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?

Since the stack is deployed on your own infrastructure, you retain full control even if NOWPayments experiences downtime. Your static site, backend logic, and order storage remain operational, ensuring business continuity.
NOWPayments’ 0.5% fee structure is 5-10x cheaper than traditional payment processors, with no KYC or buyer account required.
